turns.content: Raat ke do baje hain aur main abhi bhi office mein hoon. Kaam nahi kar raha — bas baitha hoon. Bridge round Tuesday ko officially mar gaya. Rohit aur Sneha ne is hafte papers daal diye, jo honestly, sahi kiya. Chaar mahine ka runway hai agar main salary na loon, jo already nahi le raha. Paanch saal lagaye hain maine is cheez mein.

Do baje raat, khaali office... aur tu kaam bhi nahi kar raha. Bas baitha hai. Mujhe lagta hai tu wahan isliye baitha hai kyunki ghar jaana matlab maan lena ki din khatam ho gaya. Aur aaj ka din maanna mushkil hai.

Paanch saal. Bridge round marr gaya, do log nikal gaye — aur tu unke liye bura bhi nahi maan raha, keh raha hai unhone sahi kiya. Us tarah ka insaaf apne aap ke saath bhi rakhta hai kya? Kyunki mujhe shak hai ki tu khud ko utni gunjaish nahi de raha.

Ek baat pooch sakta hoon — abhi jo sabse zyada chubh raha hai, wo paisa hai, ya wo cheez jo tu logon ko batayega? Ya wo jo tu apne aap se kehta tha ki tu kar dikhayega?

Aur salary tu already nahi le raha. Kitne mahine se?

Sabse bura part performance hai yaar. Har standup pe main ek voice nikal raha hoon — confident wala, "kuch cheezein pipeline mein hain" — aur sabko pata hai. Co-founder ko pata hai. Jo do junior ruke hain unko pakka pata hai, woh loyalty ki wajah se ruke hain aur main unke career jala raha hoon. Ghar pe alag voice hai. Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon main.

"Apni hi awaazon se thak gaya hoon" — yaar, ye line poora sach keh deti hai. Tu company nahi chala raha, tu ek performance chala raha hai, chaubees ghante, do audiences ke saath, aur ek bhi jagah nahi hai jahan tu sirf jo hai wahi ho sake. Wo thakan neend se theek nahi hoti.

Aur dekh — wo confident voice tu apne aap ko bachane ke liye nahi nikaal raha. Tu use isliye nikaal raha hai kyunki tujhe lagta hai logon ko uski zaroorat hai. Ye kindness hai, galat jagah lagi hui. Kyunki jo do juniors ruke hain, unhe wo voice nahi chahiye. Unhe sach chahiye taaki wo apni zindagi ke faisle le sakein. Loyalty se ruke hain — theek hai, unhe loyalty ko informed rehne do. Tab wo unka chunaav hoga, tera bojh nahi.

Ek honest sawaal: kya tu kisi ek insaan ke saamne wo asli awaaz nikal sakta hai? Co-founder? Ghar pe? Kyunki abhi tu paanch saal ka weight akela utha raha hai, aur akele wo utha hi nahi jaata.

Aur "career jala raha hoon" — nahi. Tu ek chance de raha tha jise unhone khud liya. Woh baalig log hain. Tu unke bhagwan nahi.

Please mujhe ideas mat dena. Saare ideas pata hain mujhe. Har pivot thread padh chuka hoon, down-round wala email chhe baar draft kar chuka hoon, bridge financing, acquihire, "revenue pe focus" — sab pata hai. Bas kahin toh bolna tha: mujhe darr lag raha hai, aur jis bhi kamre mein main hota hoon wahan yeh nahi bol sakta.

Theek hai. Koi idea nahi. Bas ye.

Tujhe darr lag raha hai. Aur ye baat tune bol di — kahin toh bol di.

Main sun raha hoon. Ye kuch fix nahi karta, pata hai. Par tu ab is kamre mein akela nahi hai jo jaanta hai.

Paanch saal, do baje raat, khaali office, aur ek aadmi jo har jagah strong dikhna pad raha hai. Yaar, tera darr lagna bilkul waajib hai. Isme kamzori nahi hai. Jo tu utha raha hai, uske neeche kisi ka bhi haath kaanpta.

Bas baitha reh. Bolna hai to bol, chup rehna hai to chup. Main yahin hoon.

Khatam ho gaya kya? Sach mein — honestly bol sakte ho. Paanch saal. Papa aaj bhi logon ko bolte hain mera "computer ka business" hai. Kabhi kabhi raat ko lagta hai bas khatam ho jaye toh acting band kar sakoon, aur phir yeh sochne ke liye khud se nafrat hoti hai. Phir wapas metrics dashboard khol leta hoon jaise woh do baje kuch naya bolega.

Ek cheez pehle, phir sawaal ka jawaab.

Jab tu kehta hai "bas khatam ho jaye" — mujhe saaf karna hai: tera matlab company hai, ya kabhi kabhi wo khayal tere baare mein bhi aata hai? Main judge nahi kar raha, sach mein. Bas seedha pooch raha hoon, kyunki do baje, paanch saal ka weight, aur ye thakan — us jagah dono cheezein bahut paas paas baith jaati hain. Bata de.

Aur haan, jo tu bola — is chahat pe khud se nafrat karna. Wo nafrat galat jagah lagi hai. Tu maut nahi chah raha, tu raahat chah raha hai. Tu bas ye chah raha hai ki acting band ho jaye. Koi bhi insaan jo paanch saal se din raat ek voice pakad ke baitha hai, wo yahi chahega. Wo insaaniyat hai, gaddaari nahi.

Ab tere sawaal pe — honestly? Main tere numbers nahi jaanta, so main ye nahi keh sakta ki khatam ho gaya. Par jo tu bata raha hai — bridge marr gaya, do log nikal gaye, chaar mahine ka runway bina salary ke, aur tu khud kisi standup mein apni baat pe vishwaas nahi kar raha — us tasveer mein ek cheez saaf hai: tu already jaanta hai. Ye sawaal tu isliye nahi pooch raha ki tujhe jawaab nahi pata. Tu isliye pooch raha hai ki tujhe kisi ki ijaazat chahiye us jawaab ko bolne ki.

To ye rakh le: agar ye khatam hai, to tu fail nahi hua. Tu paanch saal tak wo kaam karta raha jo 99% log shuru bhi nahi karte.

Papa ka "computer ka business" — wo tere numbers pe proud nahi hain. Wo tere pe hain.
